title: ITIN application (Form W-7) supporting documents
use_when: Pick this when someone on the return needs a new ITIN or must renew an expired one with Form W-7.
note: Built from the IRS ITIN supporting documents page and the Instructions for Form W-7 (Rev. 12/2024). The IRS requires original documents or copies certified by the issuing agency, current on the date of submission, and does not accept notarized copies except in limited military cases; exceptions to the tax return requirement are not covered here.

itin-docs.name: IRS, ITIN supporting documents (web page, last reviewed or updated 28-Oct-2026)

situations.no-passport: Applicant does not have a valid passport
situations.dependent-residency: Dependent applicant must prove U.S. residency
situations.student-under-24: Dependent applicant is a student under age 24
situations.age-18-plus: Dependent applicant is age 18 or older
situations.ssn-denied: The Social Security Administration found the applicant not eligible for an SSN
situations.military-overseas: Dependent or spouse of U.S. military personnel applying from overseas or an APO/FPO address

items.label: Completed Form W-7
The original federal tax return the ITIN is needed for
items.detail: Form W-7 is attached to the front of the return unless an exception applies.

items.label: Letter of denial from the Social Security Administration
Original valid passport, or a copy certified by the issuing agency
items.detail: A passport is the only stand-alone document; it proves both identity and foreign status. Current only if the expiration date has not passed before Form W-7 is submitted. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: All U.S. visa pages with a certified copy of the passport
items.detail: Needed if a visa is required for the Form W-7 application. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

sections.name: Two documents when there is no valid passport

items.label: Two supporting documents: one to prove identity and another to prove foreign status
items.detail: One document must show the applicant's photo, except for dependents under age 14 (or under age 18 if a student). Choose from the documents below. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) photo identification
items.detail: Proves identity or foreign status. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Visa issued by the U.S. Department of State
items.detail: Proves identity or foreign status. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Foreign military identification card
items.detail: Proves identity or foreign status. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: National identification card
items.detail: Proves identity or foreign status. Must show name, photo, address, birthdate and expiration date, and not be expired. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Foreign voter's registration card
items.detail: Proves identity or foreign status. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Civil birth certificate
items.detail: An original is required for applicants under age 18 without a valid passport. Proves foreign status only if the certificate is foreign. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Medical records (dependents under age 6 only)
items.detail: Shot or immunization record, or a dated and signed letter from a medical provider on official letterhead; must show the child's name, birthdate and address, the doctor's name and medical facility's address, and a date of care no more than 12 months from the date the application is submitted. Proves foreign status only if foreign.

items.label: School records (dependents under age 24 if a student)
items.detail: Report card, transcript, or a dated and signed letter from a school official on official letterhead showing attendance or coursework with grades; must show the student's name and address, the school's name and address, and term dates ending no more than 12 months from the date the application is submitted. Proves foreign status only if foreign.

items.label: U.S. driver's license
items.detail: Proves identity only. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: U.S. military identification card
items.detail: Proves identity only. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Foreign driver's license
items.detail: Proves identity only. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: U.S. state identification card
items.detail: Proves identity only. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

sections.name: Proof of U.S. residency for dependents

items.label: Passport showing a date of entry into the U.S.
items.detail: Proves U.S. residency for a dependent. Without a date of entry, one more original document below is needed. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Under age 6: U.S. medical record, U.S. school record, U.S. state identification card or U.S. visa
items.detail: One original document; a medical or school record must show a U.S. address. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Age 6 to under 18: U.S. school record, U.S. state identification card, U.S. driver's license or U.S. visa
items.detail: One original document. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Age 18 or older: U.S. school record (only if under age 24), U.S. state identification card, U.S. driver's license or U.S. visa; or a U.S. bank statement, U.S. rental statement or U.S. utility bill
items.detail: The statement or bill must list the applicant's name and U.S. address. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Copy of the servicemember's U.S. military ID
items.detail: Required if notarized copies of identification documents are submitted. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.
